{{Quote|As the designated regent of fifteen hundred systems, I speak for thousands of worlds that have urged me to allow them to stay neutral in this war.|Duchess Satine Kryze, leader of the Council of Neutral Systems|<ref name="Voyage of Temptation">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>}}
The '''Council of Neutral Systems''' was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] organization that represented over 1,500 [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] wishing to remain neutral during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
Led by [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], the members of the Council of Neutral Systems included [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Kin Robb/Legends|Kin Robb]] and [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]]. Kryze also attempted to recruit [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] Senators [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] and [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] for the council, while separately combating the emerging [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] movement.

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the leader of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], referred to the Council of Neutral Systems as a potential source of support and resources to draw upon while discussing [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|taking over Mandalore]] and forming a third front in the Clone Wars to oppose the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], having formed a tenuous alliance with the Sith Lord under the emergent [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].
